title: Sharp Statistical Thresholds for Attributed Gaussian Graph Matching
abstract: arXiv:2603.23305v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: We investigate the problem of matching networks where both edge weights and node features are correlated following a specific node correspondence. While prior work has established sharp thresholds for matching either graphs or features individually, the joint setting has been significantly less explored. In this study, we derive precise information-theoretic thresholds for exact recovery, almost-exact recovery, and partial recovery of the underlying alignment. These are expressed in terms of graph and feature correlation strengths, the number of nodes, and the dimension of the features. Interestingly, whereas an all-or-nothing phase transition is observed in the standard graph-matching scenario, the inclusion of contextual information at the node level introduces a richer structure: the exact-recovery threshold separates from the shared threshold for almost-exact and partial recovery. translated_abstract: 我们研究网络匹配问题，其中边权重和节点特征都按照特定的节点对应关系相关联。虽然先前的工作已经为单独匹配图或特征分别建立了尖锐阈值，但联合设置的情形却很少被探索。在本研究中，我们推导了底层对齐的精确恢复、几乎精确恢复和部分恢复的精确信息论阈值。这些阈值由图和特征的相关强度、节点数量以及特征维度来表示。有趣的是，尽管在标准图匹配场景中观察到“全有或全无”的相变现象，但节点级上下文信息的引入带来了更丰富的结构：精确恢复阈值从几乎精确恢复和部分恢复的共享阈值中分离出来。填补了先前工作留下的空白，我们提供……
tldr: 本文针对边权重与节点特征联合相关的属性化高斯图匹配问题，推导出了精确恢复、几乎精确恢复和部分恢复的精确信息论阈值，并发现节点特征信息的引入使得精确恢复阈值从共享阈值中分离，呈现出比标准图匹配更丰富的相变结构。
en_tdlr: This paper derives sharp information-theoretic thresholds for exact, almost-exact, and partial recovery in attributed Gaussian graph matching, revealing that node-level contextual information separates the exact-recovery threshold from the shared threshold for almost-exact and partial recovery, yielding a richer phase transition structure than standard graph matching.
